history_availability: assumed observation interval end + latency; retrospective revised observations, not operational replay
climatology: unconditional empirical training distribution; mean for point prediction, quantiles for intervals, frequency for thresholds
test_policy: No test-based tuning, normalization, early stopping, calibration or feature selection. 2025 is test only in fold A and training in fold B. Prior exploration must be disclosed.

known_exposure.2025: Previously explored and used for some calibration; retrospective test, not pristine holdout
known_exposure.2026: Earlier Q2 research exists; reserved from this protocol onward, prior exposure must be audited per model

unsupported_targets.solar_flare: Validated event catalogue and coverage labels not yet available
unsupported_targets.atmospheric_density: No independent density observations matched by time, altitude, latitude and longitude
unsupported_targets.dtc: No independent target adapter in this benchmark
